note: 出售照明类物品(火把/灯笼)的商人 NPC。部分台词是花园访客(Garden Visitor)机制的台词,和本职卖货无关,详见 GLOSSARY.md 'Garden Visitor' 词条。

messages.raw: §fLooking to protect yourself or light up some tunnels?
messages.text: Looking to protect yourself or light up some tunnels?
messages.zh: 想防身,还是想照亮隧道?

messages.raw: §fWe've got torches, lanterns. Pretty much anything to suit your needs.
messages.text: We've got torches, lanterns. Pretty much anything to suit your needs.
messages.zh: 火把、灯笼我们都有,基本上你要什么都能配齐。

messages.gloss: 'doin'' 是 doing 的口语化省略拼写,翻译时保留随性语气即可,不需要逐字体现省略号。

messages.context: 作为花园访客出现时,请求玩家帮忙制作南瓜灯用来照明水晶残核
messages.text: I'm looking to make some Jack o' Lanterns to help light up the Crystal Hollows - maybe you can help me out?
messages.gloss: Jack o' Lantern(南瓜灯)是常见节日词汇可直译;此条属于 Garden Visitor 机制台词,见 GLOSSARY.md。
messages.zh: 我想做点南瓜灯,好照亮水晶残核——你能帮我一把吗?
messages.raw: §fI'm looking to make some Jack o' Lanterns to help light up the Crystal Hollows - maybe you can help me out?

messages.context: 花园访客请求完成后,给予铜币奖励
messages.text: Nice doin' business with ya! Here's some copper in return.
messages.gloss: Copper(铜)是花园系统的专有奖励货币,Garden Visitor 机制台词。
messages.zh: 跟你做生意真痛快! 这些铜就当是回礼。
messages.raw: §fNice doin' business with ya! Here's some copper in return.

messages.text: Not a problem, thanks for your time anyways.
messages.zh: 没关系,还是谢谢你抽空。
messages.raw: §fNot a problem, thanks for your time anyways.
